source: The live Aruba ED Card application bundle and the Aruba Tourism Authority ED Card guide were read on 2026-08-30. The live controls expose required passport and travel fields, name and passport length limits, alphanumeric passport normalization, and alphanumeric flight inputs. No server-side error messages are claimed.

arrival_date.label: Arrival date
arrival_date.help: The ED Card opens within seven days before travel. Use the confirmed Aruba arrival date.

passport_number.label: Passport number
passport_number.help: The live application converts this field to uppercase alphanumeric characters and exposes a 5 to 30 character limit.

first_names.label: First names
first_names.help: Copy the given names from the passport. The live application exposes a 50 character maximum.

last_name.label: Last name
last_name.help: Copy the surname from the passport. The live application exposes a 50 character maximum.

passport_expiration.label: Passport expiration date
passport_expiration.help: Use the expiration date printed in the same passport.

arrival_flight.label: Arrival flight number
arrival_flight.help: The live custom-flight input accepts letters and numbers and exposes a 10 character maximum.

departure_date.label: Departure date
departure_date.help: Use the planned date you will leave Aruba.

address.label: Home address
address.help: Use the current residence address. The live application exposes a 42 character maximum for the address line.

purpose_of_visit.label: Purpose of visit
purpose_of_visit.help: Choose the purpose that matches this trip.

email.label: Email address
email.help: Use an inbox you can open while travelling and keep the approved confirmation.
